findings.message: g_utf8_strdown: g_utf8_strdown()/g_utf8_strup() use Turkic rules when LC_CTYPE is tr_* or az_*: "INTEGER" becomes "ınteger".
findings.reason: stored in `res`; no comparison with an affected constant found
findings.fix: Use g_ascii_strdown()/g_ascii_strup() for identifiers, or g_utf8_casefold() to compare human-readable text.
